entries.source: core/finance_locks.py LOCK_DB 'easybuy' + core/app_profiles.py 'transsion_security_plugin' (FENIX-FEATURES-RESEARCH §1 documented family). EXACT plugin id public documented nahi — ye family packages hain.

entries.caution: Ye Google ka platform component hai — sirf usi surat me candidate samjho jab phone asal me kisi finance plan (M-KOPA class) ke lock me ho. Aam phone par isay hatana ghalti hogi.
entries.label: Google Device Lock Controller (financing lock)

match_rule: tokens (chhoti bari harf ki parwah kiye baghair) partition image ke standard app roots (app/, priv-app/, system/app/, system/priv-app/) me mile folder naamo aur loose .apk file naamo me dhoondhe jate hain. Token match = candidate, confirmed plugin NAHI.
note: Transsion ROM Patcher (util_transsion_rom_patcher) ki candidate list. Ye file user-editable hai. HAR entry aik CANDIDATE hai — op pehle super ke andar asal app folders/files scan karke log me dikhata hai, aur removal sirf khatarnaak-write tasdeeq (danger gate) ke baad hota hai; khamoshi se kuch nahi urta. Seed sirf un packages par hai jo is project ki research/codebase me DOCUMENTED hain (source har entry me likha hai) — andazay se koi package id yahan NAHI dali gayi.
